payload.blocks: Step 3 of phase 6 (forgent's recipe) and the first real release run of phase 7; the release code itself lands without it and answers no-recipe until it is set.
payload.headline: Which checks should forgent's release recipe in .fgos/config.yaml run before fgctl upgrade?

parts.cause: No head can write it: the window refuses every .fgos path to a unit, and config patch of release.* is denied to every head by design (only a landed change or the owner sets it). The plan said checks = land.gates, but land.gates are shell lines with pipes and {tests}/{plans} placeholders, while recipe checks run as argv with no shell, so they cannot be copied as written.

options.cost: One config patch by the owner.
options.does: checks: [[npm, test], [cargo, test, --workspace]], the definition-of-done proof of AGENTS.md L5.
options.gain: A release ships only what the full suite passes; plain argv, no shell.
options.harm: Each release waits for the full suite (tens of minutes).
options.label: Checks = the DoD suite

options.cost: One config patch by the owner, and keeping two copies in sync.
options.does: Each land.gates line wrapped as [sh, -c, '<line>'] with the {tests} and {plans} placeholders removed.
options.gain: Same checks as every land, fast.
options.harm: Shell back in the release path, and the land gates are not the full proof; they ran already on every land.
options.label: Checks = land.gates via sh -c

parts.recommendation: Use the DoD suite: a release is the moment the whole tree must be green, and argv with no shell keeps the recipe safe. Apply with fgos config patch from the main checkout (outside any head).

scope.allows: Setting release.* in forgent's .fgos/config.yaml once, for this project.
scope.forbids: Changing the release code, the permission table or any other project's config.

parts.what: Phase 6 adds release run: the supervisor runs the project's release recipe (checks, apply, probe, rollback) from .fgos/config.yaml. forgent's recipe still has to be written there. apply = [fgctl, upgrade], probe = [node, test/live/head-grant-probe.live.mjs], rollback = [fgctl, repair], reversible = true are settled by the plan; the checks are not.
